currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete original medium-fi greenhouse exterior: log base on pale plinth, genuinely transparent gable panes and glazed end, timber rafters/purlins, two opening roof lights, boarded entry/fuel bay with open wooden door, coarse split-log alcove, opposite-end pale chimney and supported threshold. Simple inner benches are reconstructed for the clear-roof view. Reuse existing wood_log, wood_plain, wood_vertical, plaster_lime and stone_limestone graphs plus a texture-free clear-glass material; no private atlas, copied photograph pixels, flowers, trees or people baked into the building.
